defs.def: a flat thin piece of any material, normally square or rectangular 薄片，薄板（多指正方形或长方形的）

ex.s: During autumn, these same mountains are gold, and in winter they are covered in sheets white frost.

ex.s: As there were no hills in McFarland, their coach, Jim White, made them run up and down large piles of nut shells covered in white plastic sheets.
